welcome.title: Yoga Teacher Training
welcome.p1: Welcome to YogaGarhi, a sacred space where ancient wisdom meets modern living. Rooted in the timeless traditions of yoga and wellness, YogaGarhi is more than just a place to practice – it is a sanctuary for self-discovery, healing, and inner transformation.
welcome.inTraining1: Learn Hatha, Ashtanga & Vinyasa with alignment and safety
welcome.inTraining3: Practice real teaching skills, not just personal practice
welcome.p2: At YogaGarhi, we believe that yoga is not only about postures but a way of life. Our approach blends the depth of classical yogic practices with contemporary insights to create a holistic journey of the body, mind, and soul.
welcome.quote: "Every breath is a step towards freedom, every practice a journey towards wholeness."

whyChoose.heading: THE YOGAGARHI DIFFERENCE
whyChoose.preTtcBadge: Preparation for your YTTC Free Program
whyChoose.preTtcDesc: Wondering if you are truly ready for a Yoga Teacher Training Course (TTC)? This preparatory program is designed specifically for practitioners who want to test their readiness. While most schools start on day one, we begin weeks earlier — online and completely free — helping you build a solid foundation so you arrive confident, grounded, and stress-free.
whyChoose.repeatDesc: Your learning never stops. Return to future 200-hour batches in Bali tuition-free anytime to refresh your knowledge, assist classes, or deepen your sadhana.
whyChoose.communityDesc: Join an authentic, lifelong international community of like-minded teachers, practitioners, and seekers supporting each other worldwide.
whyChoose.lineageDesc: Study authentic, traditional yoga passed down directly through Himalayan masters, combining classical practice with practical, living philosophy.
whyChoose.smallGroupDesc: We deliberately cap our batch sizes at 8–10 students to guarantee individual attention, precise posture adjustments, and personal mentoring.

dosha.title: Discover Your Prakriti
dosha.desc: In Ayurveda, your unique constitution—your Prakriti—determines which yoga practices will bring you into balance. One size never fits all.
dosha.philosophy: At YogaGarhi, we teach multi-style yoga not to confuse, but to liberate. By understanding Hatha, Vinyasa, Ashtanga, and Iyengar as complete systems, you learn to adapt yoga to the individual—not force the individual into yoga.

overview.heading: Course Overview & Ashram Experience
overview.story: Our 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali is a full, beginner-to-intermediate level course for students who want to become confident yoga teachers or deeply understand yoga for their own life. YogaGarhi is in Gianyar, only about 15 km from Ubud, so you enjoy a peaceful, green village setting close to nature with easy access to Bali’s main yoga and culture center. During the training, you practice asanas every day, learn correct alignment, study pranayama, meditation, yoga philosophy, anatomy, and full teaching methodology. Step by step, you build strength in your body, clarity in your mind, and the skills to guide safe and meaningful classes for others.
